title: UGDLUCK Solar Wall Light Outdoor Sconce 2 Pack

comparisons.notes: Brand UGDLUCK, model/MPN CD006, 2 Pack, 3000/4000/6000K. Store SKU matches the Woot ASIN B0F2HS1K7D; product feed shows available=true.

writeup: Woot has the UGDLUCK CD006 up-and-down solar wall sconce 2-pack, new, for $25.99. Buckmere sells the same 2-pack for $89.98, so this is about 71% below other stores we verified. Each light runs up to 12 hours on a full charge and switches between 3000K, 4000K and 6000K. Woot caps orders at 10 per customer.
